name: 6 AN to 1/4" NPT Adapter
title: 6 AN to 1/4" NPT Adapter
description:
The 6 AN to 1/4" NPT Adapter is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to NPT Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to NPT ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

the AN to NPT Adapters are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with the nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference the installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
